blendVariants.label: Maduro
blendVariants.title: The Wise Man Maduro Corona
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Espresso, cocoa, dark chocolate, black pepper, earth and molasses sweetness give the Maduro a darker, fuller profile than the Corojo. The Mexican San Andrés wrapper adds richer chocolate and coffee weight over the same Estelí, Condega and Jalapa core, with sweetness and spice building through the smoke.
blendVariants.noteHtml: The exact 5″ × 48 Maduro Corona has drawn strong praise for construction and rich cocoa-pepper character, including a 93-point Cigar Press review, although other reviewers found the current My Father version less complex than the older Aganorsa-made Wise Man Maduro.
productionLines: Handmade in Nicaragua at My Father Cigars
Filler: Nicaraguan Estelí, Condega and Jalapa
